title: Not Impressed With This CAR WASH Product - Honest Review
description:
Car wash product review on some waterless wash and what I think is better.

I know, I know, I’m gonna receive a lot of hate for this video. Please understand an honest review is way more important to me than a new potential sponsor. I was really disappointed in the ‘Waterless Wash’ from Adams Polishes. I really gave the product a chance. 
I even cleaned the car before by hand. Unfortunately, the product wasn’t effective enough with these water spots. My cheap Walmart product handled the job flawlessly. I even had Laura’s brutally honest opinion too help set things straight. If you have any tips or ticks to this soap I’d love to hear it. 
If you have a better polish and wash I should try… Send it my way. Challenge accepted. 

Thanks to everyone who sent me fan mail and products to test out! Hope you enjoyed this video and hanging out with the Joyride Family.
